Scale
How much bigger the character becomes: 2 is twice the size, 0.5 half.
The factor every length is multiplied by. It is used when you press Scale.
Use a scale between 0.05 and 20.
Parts
Which parts of the character are scaled. Leave all three ticked unless you know you want only some.
Models ({0})
Every model in the chrbnd: vertices, bones, dummy polys and bounding boxes.
Skeleton
The animation skeleton's rest pose in the anibnd.
Animation Clips ({0})
Every clip's bone movement and root motion, so the character walks the right distance for its size. Turns are kept exactly.
Behavior ({0} files)
The behavior character file: foot and hand IK (how far the feet reach for the ground) and, in DS3 and Bloodborne, the character controller capsule.
Body Size Params ({0} NpcParam rows)

The capsule the character collides with the map and other characters with (height, radius, offset) and other body size fields, on every NpcParam row that uses this model. Edited in the Param Editor as one undo step; save the params to keep them.
